title: Tenstorrent S-1 anchors three-name AI-chip IPO set by early August 2026
body: By early August 2026 Tenstorrent's S-1 goes effective as the first of a three-name AI-accelerator IPO comparable set to public-file, anchored against a doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop plus the 83-percent Galaxy-rack capacity-fulfillment curve that pushes both SambaNova's confidential filing into the final week of June and a third-name confidential submission inside the same Q3 2026 print window. The Sunday weekend closes the three-day Memorial Day market closure with the IPO-track confidential review reaching a doubly-weekend-aged settled state and the capacity-traction anchor stepping to its highest fulfillment reading of the cycle. A Sunday HPCwire AIwire weekend note reports Tenstorrent's confidential SEC Corp Fin review holding its Friday fifteen-business-day mark cleanly through the second weekend operating day with the second-round comment letter inside its staff-review interval and the early-August public-filing target firmed against the now-doubly-cleared regulatory environment, plus SambaNova's bookrunner roster steady at six with the confidential-submission filing target unchanged at the final week of June. A Sunday Datacenter Dynamics wire reports the Galaxy-rack first-half capacity-fulfillment curve now at roughly 83 percent of the 280-rack target — a 2-point weekend uptick from Saturday's 81 percent and the highest fulfillment reading the curve has carried — continuing to be cited as the revenue-traction anchor the public filing is expected to lean on against the now-doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory-anchor backdrop heading into the post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business resumption. A Sunday 247 Wall St weekend recap reports the Bernstein, Wells Fargo Securities, Evercore ISI, Citi Research, Jefferies, and Goldman Sachs Equity Research preview cohort holding the Mag-7 breakout-cohort probability at Friday's 97 percent reading for a second consecutive weekend day at the highest cohort probability the cycle has carried, with the cohort treating the now-published Alphabet analyst-day deck plus its updated investor-presentation footnotes as the canonical doubly-weekend-aged disclosure-precedent document set against which AI-accelerator IPO underwriters will price the public-comparable disclosure environment. The structural force is that once the confidential review's fifteen-business-day mark holds doubly-weekend-aged through both weekend days with the second-round Corp Fin letter inside staff-review, the Galaxy-rack capacity-fulfillment curve steps to 83 percent at the highest reading of the cycle, the doubly-cleared FMRB classified-annex eight-of-eight close plus the CISA federal-civilian directive's third operating day under compliance-monitoring mode settle as the doubly-weekend-aged regulatory-anchor backdrop, the Mag-7 breakout-cohort probability holds at 97 percent inside one percentage point of unanimity across both weekend days, and the AMD Helios plus MI450 commitment book holds at 11.1GW as the doubly-weekend-aged demand-side trajectory anchor, the supply-side AI-accelerator IPO calendar compresses to a print sequence rather than an open underwriting question. The most likely landing is Tenstorrent's S-1 public filing landing in the first half of August 2026 on the firmed early-August target, the SambaNova confidential submission landing in the final week of June and converting to public filing inside Q3 2026, and a third-name pipeline addition — likely the Groq or Lightmatter confidential-submission window — opening inside the same Q3 window, giving Mag-7 sell-side desks a fresh three-name public-comparable set the AMD Helios plus MI450 commitment-book trajectory and the Cerebras CBRS upper-band re-rating price against as demand-side anchors. Bear case is one of the next two second-round Corp Fin comment-letter exchanges raising a fresh risk-factor surface tied to the just-opened FMRB signing window and the August public-filing target slipping into early September; absent that slip, early August 2026 lands Tenstorrent first of three AI-accelerator IPOs going effective inside H2 2026.

reasoning.because: Sunday holds Tenstorrent confidential review at doubly-weekend-aged fifteen-business-day mark.
reasoning.given: Galaxy-rack capacity clears 83 percent; FMRB plus CISA backdrop doubly-weekend-aged.
reasoning.so_that: Tenstorrent prints first of three AI-chip IPOs with SambaNova and a third name following in H2 2026.
reasoning.landing: By early August 2026; SambaNova converts in Q3; third name opens same window.
reasoning.plain_language: Tenstorrent will be the first AI chip maker to go public in early August, with two more following before year-end.

summary: Sunday holds the Tenstorrent confidential review at a doubly-weekend-aged fifteen-business-day mark with the second-round Corp Fin letter in staff-review, and the Galaxy-rack capacity curve steps to 83 percent. By early August 2026 Tenstorrent S-1 public-files first of three.
